plugins.name: claudeTalk
plugins.description: Voice for Claude Code on Windows: talk mode where Claude speaks to you (edge-tts) with a distinct voice per parallel session, local Whisper dictation on GPU, hands-free "Oye Claude" that sends to your last Claude session from any app, and a liquid glass overlay that confirms each send.
